title: Epic Mountain Landscapes: Golden Hour Tutorial
description: Generate cinematic mountain landscapes with perfect golden hour lighting. From horizon to foreground details, this tutorial covers the full layering technique.

prompt.main: epic mountain landscape, snow-capped peaks at golden hour, dramatic clouds breaking over ridges, mirror-perfect reflection in alpine lake, pine trees in foreground, atmospheric perspective, ansel adams inspired, kodak ektar 100 film, 8k landscape photography --v 6.1 --ar 16:9 --s 750
prompt.negative: --no blurry, oversaturated, text, watermark, low quality

explained.why: Widescreen aspect ratio 鈥?perfect for landscape banners and desktop wallpapers.
High stylize lets MJ compose dramatic lighting and rich detail.
v6.1 is the most photorealistic MJ version 鈥?beats v5 on natural detail.

tutorial.intro: Great landscapes live on layered depth: sky, peaks, midground, foreground. MJ will fill each layer if you cue them.
steps: Sky layer: dramatic clouds breaking over ridges 鈥?anchors the lighting direction.
Peak layer: snow-capped peaks at golden hour 鈥?main subject + time.
Midground: mirror-perfect reflection in alpine lake 鈥?adds symmetry and depth.
Foreground: pine trees in foreground 鈥?gives scale to the mountains.
Style anchor: ansel adams inspired, kodak ektar 100 film 鈥?locks it to classic landscape photography.
tutorial.tips: Photographers know: golden hour side-lighting is what makes mountains "epic". Use "golden hour" or "magic hour" instead of "sunset" for more dramatic results.
